purpose: Restore the factory framework flag that libqti_vndfwk_detect turns into isRunningWithVendorEnhancedFramework(); the camera CHI override selects kaanapali_gsi.xml instead of nezha.xml on SoC 660 when it is false and ro.build.product is not generic_arm64.

stock_evidence.factory_odm_build_prop_va_odm: ro.vendor.qti.va_odm.support=1 (line 42; the ODM image is shipped byte-identically and this key loads on the current build)

current_build_evidence.property_context_on_current_build: u:object_r:vendor_default_prop:s0 via the ro.vendor. prefix in plat_property_contexts; the provider already opens that context file successfully in the retained strace

chi_override.address_kind: ELF virtual address; the executable segment has file offset equal to its virtual address, so uprobe offsets equal these values
chi_override.soc_jump_table: 0x11279b indexed by soc_id-0x241; entries for 0x294 and 0x295 are byte 0 -> 0x4e5750
chi_override.assignment: 0x4e56e0-0x4e56e8 into the auxiliary object at ExtensionModule+0x480, string +0xd8
chi_override.picker_call: 0x4f70cc with the effective selector C string in x1

consumers.note: the flag is global; stock runs all of these with it set to 1

loader: AOSP init loads /system/build.prop keys as the init context through CheckPermissions; the built platform policy allows init to set every property type; only ctl., sys.powerctl and the restorecon key are filtered
